templates.machine_start_gcode:
M17 ; enable steppers
M862.1 P[nozzle_diameter] A{((is_extruder_used[0] and (required_nozzle_HRC[0] > 0)) ? 1 : (is_extruder_used[1] and (required_nozzle_HRC[1] > 0)) ? 1 : (is_extruder_used[2] and (required_nozzle_HRC[2] > 0)) ? 1 : (is_extruder_used[3] and (required_nozzle_HRC[3] > 0)) ? 1 : (is_extruder_used[4] and (required_nozzle_HRC[4] > 0)) ? 1 : 0)} F{(true ? 1 : 0)} ; nozzle check
M862.3 P "MK4" ; printer model check
M862.5 P2 ; g-code level check
M862.6 P "Input shaper" ; FW feature check
M862.6 P "MMU3" ; FW feature check
M115 U6.5.7+12836

; setup MMU
M708 A0x0b X5   ; extra load distance
M708 A0x0d X140 ; unload feeedrate
M708 A0x11 X140 ; load feedrate
M708 A0x14 X50  ; slow feedrate
M708 A0x1e X12  ; Pulley current to ~200mA
M708 A0x12 X90  ; selector feedrate mm/s
M708 A0x13 X400 ; idler feedrate deg/s
M708 A0x0f X400 ; selector acceleration mm/s2

M555 X{(min(print_bed_max[0], first_layer_print_min[0] + 32) - 32)} Y{(max(0, first_layer_print_min[1]) - 4)} W{((min(print_bed_max[0], max(first_layer_print_min[0] + 32, first_layer_print_max[0])))) - ((min(print_bed_max[0], first_layer_print_min[0] + 32) - 32))} H{((first_layer_print_max[1])) - ((max(0, first_layer_print_min[1]) - 4))}

G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode

M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M104 S{((filament_notes[initial_tool]=~/.*MBL160.*/) ? 160 : (filament_notes[initial_tool]=~/.*HT_MBL10.*/) ? (nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool] - 10) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "PC" or filament_type[initial_tool] == "PA") ? (nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool] - 25) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "TPU") ? 210 : (filament_type[initial_tool]=~/.*PET.*/) ? 175 : 170)} ; set extruder temp for bed leveling
M109 R{((filament_notes[initial_tool]=~/.*MBL160.*/) ? 160 : (filament_notes[initial_tool]=~/.*HT_MBL10.*/) ? (nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool] - 10) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "PC" or filament_type[initial_tool] == "PA") ? (nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool] - 25) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "TPU") ? 210 : (filament_type[initial_tool]=~/.*PET.*/) ? 175 : 170)} ; wait for temp

M84 E ; turn off E motor

G28 ; home all without mesh bed level

G1 X42 Y-4 Z5 F4800

M302 S155 ; lower cold extrusion limit to 155C

{if filament_type[initial_tool]=="TPU"}
G1 E-4 F2400 ; retraction
{else}
G1 E-2 F2400 ; retraction
{endif}

M84 E ; turn off E motor

G29 P9 X10 Y-4 W32 H4

{if first_layer_bed_temperature[initial_tool]<=60}M106 S100{endif}

G0 Z40 F10000

M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp

M107

;
; MBL
;
M84 E ; turn off E motor
G29 P1 ; invalidate mbl & probe print area
G29 P1 X0 Y0 W130 H20 C ; probe near purge place
G29 P3.2 ; interpolate mbl probes
G29 P3.13 ; extrapolate mbl outside probe area
G29 A ; activate mbl

; prepare for purge
M104 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool]}
G0 X0 Y-4 Z15 F4800 ; move away and ready for the purge
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool]}

G92 E0
M569 S0 E ; set spreadcycle mode for extruder

T[initial_tool]
G1 E{parking_pos_retraction + extra_loading_move - 15} F1000 ; load to the nozzle

;
; Extrude purge line
;
G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
G1 E{(filament_type[initial_tool] == "TPU" ? 4 : 2)} F2400 ; deretraction after the initial one before nozzle cleaning
G0 E7 X15 Z0.2 F500 ; purge
G0 X105 E36 F500 ; purge
G0 X115 E4 F650 ; purge
G0 X125 E4 F800 ; purge
G0 X128 Z0.05 F8000 ; wipe, move close to the bed
G0 X131 Z0.2 F8000 ; wipe, move quickly away from the bed

G92 E0
M221 S100 ; set flow to 100%
templates.machine_end_gcode:
{if layer_z < printable_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+1, printable_height)} F720 ; Move print head up{endif}
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X241 Y170 F3600 ; park
{if layer_z < printable_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+23, printable_height)} F300 ; Move print head up{endif}
M702 ; unload the current filament
G4 ; wait
M572 S0 ; reset PA
M593 X T2 F0 ; disable IS
M593 Y T2 F0 ; disable IS
M84 X Y E ; disable motors
; max_layer_z = [max_layer_z]
